description: Retrieve stdout/stderr and crash output for a deployment. Call this whenever a deployment errors or a server exits unexpectedly — the crash exit code usually identifies the problem faster than redeploying does. Logs for stopped deployments are only retained if Endpoint Storage was configured on the version beforehand.

max_characters.description: Truncate logs to this length, keeping the tail. Default 8000.

name: edgegap_get_deployment_logs
title: Get container logs for a deployment
